answer: Agents bond stake in a vault and register a Semaphore/RLN commitment to an epoch polynomial, whose evaluations yield rate-limit shares bound to their nullifier. If the same identity submits conflicting messages in that epoch, the distinct shares interpolate the Shamir secret and expose its private key. The verifiable exposure links to the bonded agent, enabling immediate collateral slashing; juniper and orchard labels have no effect on verification.
